Waste Management.description: Waste management is the process of collecting, separating, treating, recycling and safely disposing of waste.
Waste Management.recommendation: Follow the 5Rs: Refuse, Reduce, Reuse, Repurpose and Recycle.

Types of Waste.Organic Waste: Food scraps, vegetable peels, fruit waste, leaves and garden waste.
Types of Waste.Plastic Waste: Plastic bottles, containers, packaging materials and plastic bags.
Types of Waste.Paper Waste: Newspapers, cardboard, notebooks and paper packaging.
Types of Waste.Metal Waste: Aluminium cans, steel cans and other metal items.
Types of Waste.E-Waste: Old computers, mobile phones, chargers, keyboards, batteries and electronic devices.
Types of Waste.Hazardous Waste: Materials such as certain chemicals, paints, batteries and other potentially harmful materials.

Recycling.Plastic: Clean and dry recyclable plastics before placing them in the appropriate recycling collection.
Recycling.Paper: Keep paper clean and dry. Cardboard can usually be recycled when it is not contaminated.
Recycling.Glass: Glass bottles and jars can commonly be recycled. Follow local collection rules.
Recycling.Metal: Metal cans are commonly recyclable when properly emptied and cleaned.
Recycling.E-Waste: Electronic waste should be taken to an authorized e-waste collection or recycling facility.
Recycling.Batteries: Do not put batteries in ordinary waste. Use appropriate battery collection facilities.

Composting.description: Composting converts suitable organic waste into nutrient-rich compost.
Composting.examples: Fruit peels, vegetable scraps, dry leaves and garden waste can be suitable for composting.

Recommendations.Plastic Reduction: Carry reusable bags and bottles and avoid unnecessary single-use plastics.
Recommendations.Food Waste: Plan meals, store food properly and compost suitable food scraps.
Recommendations.Electronic Waste: Repair or donate usable electronics and send unusable electronics to authorized e-waste recyclers.
Recommendations.Paper: Use digital documents when practical and reuse paper before recycling it.

Suggestions.Home: Keep separate containers for different types of waste.
Suggestions.College: Place clearly labelled waste bins around classrooms and common areas.
Suggestions.Community: Organize waste-segregation awareness programs and clean-up activities.
Suggestions.Environment: Reduce waste generation before focusing on recycling.
